item.title: Cleveland State men rally for fifth win in a row, 91-78 over Oakland
item.description: Cleveland State made 12 3-pointers in the second half to win its fifth game in a row, 91-78 over Oakland on Feb. 4 at Woodling Gym. The Vikings (10-14, 6-7 Horizon) trailed by as many as 11 points in the second half. They took the lead with 6 minutes, 55 seconds remaining and finished with 17 3-pointers for the game. Tre Beard paced CSU with 24 points, and Jaidon Lipscomb added 18. Dayan Nessah added 15 and a team-high 10 rebounds. The Vikings avenged a 23-point loss to the Grizzlies on Jan. 9.
